card.title: GST5009S Ethernet transformer diode mode measurements and schematic

source.title: PS5 Ethernet Port GST5009S Diode Readings and Pinout

claims.statement: All pins on the GST5009S Ethernet transformer should measure approximately 0.45V in diode mode.
claims.evidence: Annotation pointing to the pins with text 'All PINS +- 0,45' and 'DIODE MEASUREMENT'

card.caveats: The image does not specify the reference ground point for the diode measurement or the state of the motherboard (powered/unpowered).
